product_metadata.title: Yakasure Steamer Basket Stainless Steel Vegetable Steamer Basket Folding Steamer Insert for Veggie Egg Fish Seafood Cooking, Expandable to Fit Various Size Pot (6" to 10.5")
features: 【HEALTHIER COOKING CHOICES】 – The steamer basket with premium food grade stainless steel petals design, Steaming is a healthy cooking choice because it helps retain more than 90% of the nutrients lost when boiling.The foldable steamer basket can be used to steam veggies, seafood, eggs, meats, desserts, baby food and much more.

【EXPANDABLE & COLLAPSIBLE】 – Vegetable steamer basket collapsed diameter is 6 inches.This Steamer basket expands to 10 inches once petals are stretched out.The "wings" that fold in and out allow the steamer fit various pot/pan sizes or pressure cooker, turning any pan into a steamer. Opens like a water lily and it folds compactly to save storage space.

【REMOVABLE CENTER POST 】- 2.4" Central post helps easy insertion to the pots and safe removal from the boiling water. When your food is ready, remove it from the boiling water with a fork so won’t burn your fingers.
【MULTIPLE FUNCTIONS】 - The Steamer rack not only can be used as a food steamer basket, also you can also use it for filter extra water when washing vegetable and fruit.
【EASY TO CLEAN & EXTREMELY COMPACT 】- You can clean the steamer very easily. When You are ready to put away, then fold in to its original half size.
description: STEAMING IS A HEALTHY & FAST WAY TO PREPARE MEALS.
Thanks to this Stainless Steel Foldable Steamer Basket by Yakasure. It's Ideal for making delicious meals and steaming food without losing nutrient.

- High quality food grade material,rustproof, harmless and durable.  - Steam Foods preserves flavor and nutrients.  - Collapsible design for easy compact storage.  - Expands and adjusts to various pots, pans or pressure cooker.  - Removable central handle for steaming of larger food.  - 3 legs at the bottom keep food separate from the pot.  - Lift it from the boiling water with a fork.  - Multiple functions: It can be used as container or candy plate.  - Easy to use,Simply place the basket, feet side down,time saving.  - Dishwasher safe making it easy and faster to clean.
Collapsed Diameter is 6",Expandable to 10.5"   Buy one as a gift for your family or friends! They will love perfectly steamed veggies!A great gift for everyone!
